execution_only_revision: Resource checks immediately before prediction seal/label opening and after scoring; unchanged sample/features/models/metric gates.

canonical_specification.source_cast: Existing numeric features cast directly to float32; no fitted normalization.

selection: Highest full-year AUC; ties lower rounds then lower weight; selected positive blend must strictly beat anchor and matched-weight canonical control for full year and each calendar half; no rescue.
fit_order: 14 controls in frozen unit order, then one 1400-round pooled trajectory; no early stopping.

resources.checks: Between phases/controls, every25 native rounds, before prediction seal/labels and after scoring; observational, not OS-enforced.
